title: Time Bound for Right-Boundary Normalization
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $x$ and $o$ be Boolean words. If $M$ computes output $o$ from $x$ in exactly $T$ steps, then its right-boundary wrapper computes $o$ from $x$ in exactly $T+|x|+2$ steps, and at that time its input head is at position $|x|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$M$ computes output $o$ from $x$ in exactly $T$ steps
replaced:
Let $M$ compute output $o$ on input $x$ within time $T$. Then the right-boundary wrapper
of $M$ computes $o$ on $x$ within time $T + |x| + 2$, and after exactly that many steps
its input head is at position $|x| + 1$.
